about_the_game:
Wu Jun is 50 years old, and his family of three lives in his parents' home. However, a quarrel two months ago caused his parents to leave the city. He realizes that so far, his life has been a failure: an unhappy marriage, a poor career, and a strained relationship with his daughter. What he doesn't know is that this is just the beginning...

He is 15 months away from being fired, 18 months away from purchasing a new house and accumulating significant debt, 40 months away from discovering that he is on the brink of bankruptcy and trying to persuade his parents to come back for their money, and 60 months away from finding out that his mother has cancer, and so on...

Fortunately, you have the chance to help him change his fate, relying on randomness and your strategies.

Will he defy the odds and change his destiny? Or will he continue to depend on his parents?

Demo Content

  • A roguelite game where each card represents various daily activities.

  • The randomly arranged action cards and character cards on the field will determine his actions and encounters each month.

  • Seek balance among wealth, health, energy, and happiness. Strive to survive until the 50th round and foster good relationships with many characters.

  • Six key characters in his life.

  • Explore three areas of experience in the game (self, relationships, work).

  • Fixed events triggered by rounds and other strange randomly events.

About This Demo

  • Limited to 50 Rounds per Game: (The full version allows for 100 rounds.)

  • Only Includes Three Areas of Experience: The demo does not include "Cleaning" and "Cooking," which are part of the full version.

  • No Experience Points or Item System: Unlike the full game, you won't be able to earn experience points or use items.

  • 50 Cards in Total: Compared to over 300 cards in the full version.

  • 20+ Events: While the full version features more than 100 events.

  • Inevitable Termination: Unfortunately, in this demo, you cannot change your fate of being fired after 15 months, no matter how hard you try.

  • Unable to Become a Security Guard: Since the seventh character is not included in the demo, finding a job as a security guard after losing your current one is not an option.

  • No Online Courses: The demo does not include online courses on communicating with and taking care of the elderly, which are part of the full version.

  • Enjoy!

short_description: In a roguelite card game, spectate and simulate the next ten years of a fifty-year-old man's life. Whether he becomes a moocher who relies on his parents, or rbecome a key company member, or turns into a good father and son... it all depends on randomness and your strategy.
